items.q: How does the Privacy Scanner work?
items.a: It audits your browser environment for common privacy vulnerabilities. This includes checking for network leaks (WebRTC), browser fingerprinting (Canvas API), and the effectiveness of your tracking protection.
WebRTC is a technology for real-time communication. However, it can sometimes bypass VPNs and reveal your real local IP address. Our scanner checks if your browser is leaking this information.

Fingerprinting is a technique where websites collect small bits of data about your browser (fonts, resolution, hardware) to create a unique ID for you. This allows them to track you even without cookies.
